attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Core shape table caching/locking mechanism used by every tenant on every request is being reworked (semaphore replaced by ILocalLock, cache type changed to Task<ShapeTable>), so any subtle bug in the new locking or the new DI dependency (ILocalLock must be registered in every host) could break shape rendering or startup across all tenants."}

reason: Core shape table caching/locking mechanism used by every tenant on every request is being reworked (semaphore replaced by ILocalLock, cache type changed to Task<ShapeTable>), so any subtle bug in the new locking or the new DI dependency (ILocalLock must be registered in every host) could break shape rendering or startup across all tenants.
